name: Rebuilding Relations
source:
Lovers quarrels! There are many things people don't know about what to do after being married.

Jobs are driving those two lovely Terry and Bernard out and they try to fix this.

Do they find their answer to their marriage or is it gonna all fall apart?

[From [url=https://peppekz.itch.io/rebuilding-relations]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
恋人吵架！结婚后，有很多事情人们不知道该怎么办。

乔布斯正在赶走那两个可爱的特里和伯纳德，他们试图解决这个问题。

他们是否找到了婚姻的答案，还是婚姻会破裂？
